text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер makes a valiant attempt,
but
victory slips through her grasp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her spirits are further dampened by the
thought
that this result would have been
the same even if
Марузенски had been
in the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сэйун Скай is disappointed in Grass
Wonder,
noting that she wasn't fully
focused on the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only then does Грасс Вандер realize
she hasn't
truly clashed with her
contemporaries.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
